items.title: Polymarket BTC Trading Assistant
items.description: GitHub repository by FrondEnt. Real-time console trading assistant for Polymarket Bitcoin Up/Down 15-minute markets. Features include market selection, UP/DOWN prices, liquidity tracking, Chainlink BTC/USD price feeds, Binance spot reference, and technical analysis (Heiken Ashi, RSI, MACD, VWAP, Delta). Provides live LONG/SHORT prediction scoring. Added as reference resource for Claude Code development in Trading Tools Research list.
